reasons.Arithmetic: takeFee computes amount.div(denominator).mul(fee) — division before multiplication truncates; SafeMath helpers also use unchecked blocks on user-influenced values.

reasons.DoS: Push ETH payments via payable(...).transfer to hardcoded marketing/development receivers inside the swapback path can revert and block all taxed transfers.
reasons.Front Running: approve sets allowance directly (classic ERC20 race), and swapTokensForETH/addLiquidityETH use amountOutMin/amountMin of 0, allowing sandwich attacks.
reasons.Time manipulation: block.timestamp is used as the deadline for router swap and liquidity operations, a miner-influenceable decision variable.

reasons.Access Control: No authorization gates anywhere; poke(address) mutates another user's balance and every state-changing function (invest, divest, claimRewards, idle) is callable by anyone with no modifier or caller check.
reasons.Arithmetic: solc 0.4.10 with no SafeMath: modifyBalance(a, -value) deliberately passes a negative into a uint (wrapping subtraction), and createReward/getReward/losingAmount do value*largeConstant multiplications and divisions that can overflow or truncate to zero.
reasons.Front Running: poke() and claimRewards() are first-come races whose payoff depends on transaction ordering — observers can front-run a poke or a reward claim visible in the mempool.
reasons.Time manipulation: poke() gates on require(now > lastPing[a] + 14 hours) and lastPing is set from now, so miner-influenced block timestamps decide when funds can be seized.

reasons.Arithmetic: Raw `block.timestamp-CustomerService[msg.sender]` subtraction outside SafeMath on solc 0.4, plus unchecked MINING_LAYERS[i+1] indexing/multiplications in constant initialisers that can overflow or revert out of range.
reasons.Unchecked Return Values: emergencyERC20Drain calls token.transfer(owner, amount) and discards the returned bool.
reasons.Front Running: approve() sets the allowance directly, exposing the classic ERC20 allowance race; exchange/destroy ordering is also mempool-visible.
